name: EPIC 205954223
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 6.7 solar radii and 0.89 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 205954223 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 6.668586 (16th-84th percentiles 6.504657-6.879983), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 205954223 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 1601.738281 (16th-84th percentiles 1565.722656-1642.734375), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 1,602 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.89 solar masses and 6.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,696 K at its surface.
